This plan rescues everyone, so nothing is deferred.

1. Benighat care home is a 6-minute road from the shelter, so I collect its 2 elderly people first. That round trip costs 12 minutes, against a deferral penalty of 100.
2. I then drive to Thakre care home, load its 2 elderly people, and continue to Dhunche school to load the 2 children. That fills all 4 seats. The route back is Dhunche, Thakre, shelter. This trip costs 132 minutes. Deferring the same four people would cost 220, and rescuing only the Thakre elderly while deferring the children would cost 72 + 120 = 192.

Total driving is 12 + 132 = 144 minutes.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter benighat-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter thakre-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 thakre-care-home dhunche-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-school thakre-care-home
drive car1 thakre-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
</plan>
COST: 144
